tools.name: precio_ultimo
tools.description: Latest published price of a series (by its identifier) or of the products matching a text: price, date and week, the previous figure, whether it went up («sube»), down («baja») or stayed the same («repite»), source, licence and a link to its page with chart and history. — Último precio de una serie
